interpretation: With the CSI3 PHY gate enabled, the normal front camera produced frames and more than one million CSID3 packets with zero ECC/CRC errors. Earlier front-to-CSID3 controls without that gate produced zero frames and packets. This establishes a positive lower-lane CSID3 input control for this DT path. The iris upper-combo run still produced no frame-counter changes or packets with the gate available, so the remaining failure is specific to sensor startup/output and/or the PHY2 upper-combo path; this control does not distinguish those.
